description: This is a Java abstract class for setting up AMQP adapter integration tests, providing setup, teardown, connection, and sender creation utilities.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for AMQP adapter integration tests using Vert.x and Proton clients.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Vert.x, sets default Proton client options, and initializes test support before all tests.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the test helper and closes Vert.x after all tests.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message sender for a specified target address.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Connects to the AMQP adapter using username and password authentication.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Connects to the AMQP adapter using a client certificate for authentication.

methods.name: handleConnectAttempt
methods.description: Handles the connection establishment process and asserts remote capabilities.
